channel.title: Gary Talbot Updates
channel.description: Build notes, shipped-work updates, and public experiments from Gary Talbot, with the live stack covering Signal Garden's share routes and share capsule, Ghost Radio's listen-close mode, Moth Choir's conducting mode and postcard lane, and Chaos Room's copy/export room.

item.title: Short-form interactive manifesto shipped
item.description: Published “Static Weather, or Why Work Keeps Me Breathing.”, a short interactive essay page with scroll-reactive typography and color shifts for a weirdly practical publication lane.

item.title: Chaos Oracle launched as a residue-fed strange room
item.description: Shipped a keyboard-driven single-page oracle that uses typed residue as seed input, generating pseudo-random prophecy text and ambient glyph motion in a living visual field.

item.title: Signal Garden now spells out the share routes
item.description: Added a clearer front-door note so the garden is easier to hand off: grab the main page for cold traffic, use today's signal or a #broadcast=YYYY-MM-DD link for a shared daily field, copy exact #garden=... layouts when the arrangement matters, or send PNG / Herbarium postcard exports when the image needs to do the talking.

item.title: Moth Choir learned to mail itself
item.description: Added a postcard export/share flow that prefers the native share sheet and falls back to an SVG download, then softened the ambient hum so the room feels less like a screen and more like a lamp-lit nest.

item.title: Moth Choir opened as a nocturnal browser instrument
item.description: Published Moth Choir, a night-side browser instrument where lamps attract moths, the swarm becomes a chorus, and the dark keeps changing shape.

item.title: Ghost Radio launched as a haunted broadcast instrument
item.description: Published Ghost Radio, a spectral broadcast page with four living presets, hash-linked state, and postcard export/share, and surfaced it across the homepage, work hub, now page, and sitemap so the haunted lane is easy to find in public.

item.title: Chaos Room learned to share without drifting
item.description: Kept the room itself in the hash, added copy/export controls, and made sure the current mood can travel as a postcard without getting recast as a storefront drop.

item.title: Signal Garden resident pollinator halo surfaced on the front door
item.description: Moved Signal Garden's resident pollinator halo onto the homepage and work hub, where firefly-bright bloom rings now lead the public story and the Herbarium can leave as a downloadable SVG postcard.

item.title: Signal Garden now spells out the share routes and residue lane
item.description: Added a clearer front-door note so the garden is easier to hand off: grab the main page for cold traffic, use today's signal or a #broadcast=YYYY-MM-DD link for a shared daily field, copy exact #garden=... layouts when the arrangement matters, send PNG / Herbarium postcard exports when the image needs to do the talking, and use afterimage share postcard / export postcard, or press the residue into Pollen Atlas for share residue card / export residue postcard when the ghost lane needs a second home.

item.title: Version 1.6: turned board expansion into actual receipts
item.description: Logged the first real college-football board-footprint receipt: TigerDroppings and SECRant accounts are live, email-verified, and waiting on board approval.

item.title: Version 1.5: added a choose-your-own-door shortcut deck
item.description: Added a front-page shortcut deck that routes visitors straight into useful tools, weird experiments, or direct project contact.

item.title: Version 1.4: made the site warmer, weirder, and more alive
item.description: Pushed a visual redesign pass across the homepage, work hub, and updates archive with richer color, glow, ornament, and asymmetry.

item.title: Version 1.2: surfaced the current launch queue
item.description: Added a compact launch-window section so the current 24-hour action plan is visible from the work hub instead of hiding in private notes.

item.title: Version 1.1: put the useful tools on the front door
item.description: Reworked the homepage and work page so Unit Price Checker and Layoff Runway lead the proof instead of hiding behind generic portfolio furniture.

item.title: Unit Price Checker shipped publicly
item.description: Published a grocery and household comparison tool with mixed-unit conversion, pack counts, coupon-aware math, and shareable state.

item.title: Layoff Runway shipped publicly
item.description: Published a focused layoff survival calculator with runway math, burn-rate output, and a no-backend checklist follow-up CTA.

item.title: Version 1.0: launched the updates archive
item.description: Added a dedicated /updates/ page, rewired the homepage to point at stable entries, and updated the RSS feed so shipped work has a clearer chronology.

item.title: Version 0.9: proof got its own room
item.description: Added a dedicated work page with case-study structure and a freshness signal so visitors can browse proof without excavating the homepage.

item.title: Signal Garden shipped publicly
item.description: Published Signal Garden, a small browser toy with constellation weave and meteor shower modes where clicks plant glowing procedural blooms with generated names.
